issues.title: Searching for Channel get wrong result
issues.body:
## 🐞 Bug description
From Channel page, search return wrong result

## 🔢 Steps to Reproduce
 
Steps to reproduce the behavior:
1. Login app as admin
2. Create a new game
3. From 'Forces' tab, create some forces ( White, Blue, Red)
4. From 'Channels' tab, add some channels ( Red Chat, Red HQ, Blue Chat, Blue HQ)

![image](https://github.com/serge-web/serge/assets/107697044/6846a609-9303-434f-8968-301482d5b560)

5. Input 'Red' in searching field
6.  Notice it returns wrong result
 
![image](https://github.com/serge-web/serge/assets/107697044/728921e9-4ca8-4884-a32d-3674efbaa4d9)

## ⚙️ Expected behavior
Searching should return the channel which name contains the searching text ( Above case should return 'Red Chat' and 'Red HQ' channel)

## 🖥️ Screencasts

https://github.com/serge-web/serge/assets/107697044/9721f5a6-af6e-49b1-9e80-e1ce19c7368b



## 💻 System information
<!-- Please complete the following information (you can get most of this information from https://mybrowser.fyi/) -->
 - Browser : Chrome
 - Browser Version : Version 120.0.6099.111
